title: Point-fibre specialization on ordinary closed restrictions
statement: Fix a six-functor datum at any of the four coefficient stages and a normalized relative-product presentation R. Let J be a closed-subscheme square over the geometric point, as defined in [def-sf-relative-kunneth-constructions], whose i,j,r are ordinary closed immersions with both product projection equations. For every finite-Tor pair K,L on the original factors and every compactifications cz,cw,ct of the two closed schemes and their product, there is an isomorphism RΓ_c(Z,i*K) tensor^L RΓ_c(W,j*L) ≅ RΓ_c(Z times_k W,r*(K box L)), in exactly the finite, integral, rational or common-stage module derived category of the recorded compact-section definitions. This is relativeKunnethClosedFormula R J, and asserts no coefficient or cube compatibility.
